justifications.default: The benchmark is aligned with the modern cross-industry advanced baseline defined in the Gartner I&O Maturity Index (2026). In response to widespread cloud-native scaling and modern operational demands, even non-regulated corporate environments are expected to achieve Level 4 (Managed and Sustainable), characterized by automated telemetry, quantitatively measured execution metrics, and continuous compliance feedback loops.

INFRA_COLD_BOOT.narrative_label: sequential cold-start and database consistency verification of server infrastructure

DATA_RESTORE.narrative_label: snapshot restoration and transaction log replay from local backups

RANSOM_REBUILD.narrative_label: forensic containment, Active Directory rebuild, and bare-metal recovery
